title: Hand of Blood Relative
next_chapter_hook: The imperial dynasty envoy's carriage had already entered the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, and the news they brought was merely separated by a wall from where Chen Nian was imprisoned...

text.content: The night wind cut like a blade. In the bamboo grove at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji sat alone on a blue stone, the spiritual energy around him chaotic as a stormy sea. The Tianji Record Fragment floated before his brow center, and the glaring blood-colored prophecy still writhed slowly—"Hand of Blood Relative, Take Your Life." Five characters, each like a burning brand, seared into the softest part of his heart.

He closed his eyes, attempting to invoke the power of the Tianji Record once more to examine this prophecy. However, the intense pain from his brow center told him that today's Heavenly Fate value had been exhausted. The mysterious prophetic vision was like a scroll soaked in thick ink—he could only vaguely make out a slender palm, with a red rope tied around the wrist. That was... that was the blessing rope Chen Nian had worn since childhood!

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his knuckles white from excessive force. Images involuntarily flashed through his mind—Chen Nian at six, stuffing her only rice cake into his mouth with a smiling face; Chen Nian at ten, blocking the whip of a direct-line disciple to protect him, her eyes filled with stubborn defiance; and three years ago, on that rainy night, her heart-wrenching screams as she was dragged away...

【System Prompt: Heavenly Fate value insufficient, unable to perform deep foresight. Current remaining Heavenly Fate: 3 points】The cold prompt tone rang in his mind, and Chen Ji bitterly tugged at the corner of his mouth. Had his Heavenly Fate dropped so low that he couldn't even completely analyze prophecies? And this damn prophecy pointed directly to the person he cherished most in this life.

dialogue.content: When Niannian was taken by the Holy Sect, she was only fifteen. How could she... Wait, Heavenly Fate Lock Key...

text.content: A terrifying thought crawled up his heart like a venomous snake. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key—that was a forbidden technique medium used by the Holy Sect to manipulate Heavenly Secrets. If Chen Nian had truly been refined into a Lock Key, her body and soul would no longer be under her own control. At that point, for her, "Chen Nian" and "Chen Ji" might only be two meaningless labels...

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Besides Chen Nian, who else could be considered "blood relative"? Though Su Qingyao shared no blood ties with him, three years of fighting side by side and surviving life and death had long intertwined their fates. Ye Qing, though the Holy Demonic Sect's Saintess, was an ally he had saved with his own hands and chosen to trust. As for Mo Xiansheng... that was the remnant soul of a guardian left by his master, and should not harm him.

dialogue.content: "If one wants to take my life, why wait until the moment the prophecy foretells? If they don't want my life, then why does this prophecy appear at all?"

text.content: Just then, a cold and clear voice came from the depths of the bamboo grove: "Chen Ji, it's so late, what are you doing sitting here alone?" Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao in white garments descended like frost and snow. Her gaze fell on Chen Ji's pale face, her brow furrowed slightly, "You look terrible."

dialogue.content: "Did you secretly cultivate some forbidden technique again? The last time you used that fragment to foresight the imperial dynasty's dragon vein, you also had this half-dead look."

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Su Qingyao's rare display of concern?

choices.text: Reveal part of the truth to Su Qingyao
choices.description: Su Qingyao is the person he trusts most. Perhaps she can help analyze the true meaning of the prophecy.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might become even more worried and even take unnecessary protective actions

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao took the fragment and gazed at it for a moment, then suddenly raised her head: "This prophecy is strange—the 'Hand of Blood Relative' may not necessarily refer to blood kinship. Chen Ji, be careful of those people around you who... seem harmless."

choices.description: The secret of the Tianji Record cannot be easily revealed, not even to Su Qingyao. Maintaining thetrash persona and investigating covertly is the best strategy.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might feel disappointed at being deflected, affecting the trust between the two

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stared at him for a long while, then suddenly let out a cold laugh: "Fine, you were always like this, preferring to let things rot in your stomach rather than speak them out. Chen Ji, you better pray that those people you trust... are truly worthy of your trust."

text.content: Su Qingyao's words were like a bucket of cold water poured over his heart. Chen Ji watched her departing silhouette, his mind churning with complex ripples. This woman was too perceptive—over three years, she had countless times brushed against the edge of the truth, only to be skillfully deflected by him. If she knew the complete prophecy of the Tianji Record...

He suddenly recalled what Mo Xiansheng had said—"Every page of prophecy in the Tianji Record presents a choice that fate offers. What you choose to believe determines the answer fate gives you." Back then, he thought it was nothing but mystical nonsense, but now, savoring it carefully, he detected a bitterly profound meaning within those words.

choice.prompt: How does Chen Ji decide to investigate the truth of Chen Nian's imprisonment?

choices.text: Secretly investigate the connection between the Imperial Court and the Holy Sect
choices.description: Start from the Imperial Court's Dragon Vein—if they desire the Dragon Vein's power, there must be some transaction with the Holy Sect, perhaps finding clues about Chen Nian.
choices.risk_hint: Risk alerting the Imperial Court forces

text.content: Chen Ji returned to his quarters and retrieved a hidden communication talisman—one of the spy networks he had established in the Imperial Capital. After three breaths, the talisman warmed slightly, and tiny characters appeared: "The Imperial Court's special envoy will arrive at Tianqing Sect tomorrow, reportedly carrying clues about the Holy Maiden."

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing, leveraging the Demonic Path intelligence network
choices.description: Ye Qing's identity as the Demonic Path's Holy Maiden grants her access to the Holy Sect's internal information, perhaps allowing her to trace Chen Nian's whereabouts directly from the source.
choices.risk_hint: The complex relationship between the Demonic Path and Holy Sect may attract unnecessary trouble

text.content: Chen Ji quietly activated the secret method to contact Ye Qing. After a moment, a cold voice resonated in his mind: "Chen Gongzi, how rare for you to take the initiative to contact me. Have you encountered something interesting?" Chen Ji got straight to the point, sending over the Tianji Record's prophecy. After a long silence, Ye Qing's voice sounded again, her tone unusually grave: "Heavenly Fate Lock Key... The Holy Sect is actually refining such a thing using living people?"

Ye Qing's silence unnerved Chen Ji more than any words could. After a long while, that cold voice finally sounded again: "Chen Gongzi, I've found something. The Holy Sect is indeed refining the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, and the one overseeing this... is their Deputy Sect Master, codenamed 'Chess Player.' This person is extremely mysterious—every disciple who has seen his true face is dead. But something strange—"

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key requires two materials: one is a vessel with a special bloodline, and the other is a person... already chosen by the Tianji Record."

text.content: These words struck Chen Ji's mind like a thunderbolt. The person chosen by the Tianji Record—wasn't that himself? Could the purpose of refining Chen Nian into a Heavenly Fate Lock Key be to target him? What exactly does the Holy Sect want? Do they seek to control the Tianji Record, or to utterly destroy it?

"[System Notification: Key Intelligence Unlocked—There is a connection between the location where Chen Nian is imprisoned and the Imperial Court's Dragon Vein. The Imperial envoy's true purpose may not be the Dragon Vein, but something else entirely.] The system notification made Chen Ji's heart tighten. He suddenly realized that the Imperial Court's choice to send an envoy to Tianqing Sect at this particular moment was by no means coincidental.

dialogue.content: "They want to use Nian Nian against me... What a brilliant scheme, killing two birds with one stone."

text.content: Chen Ji stood up, the moonlight stretching his shadow long and lonely. His gaze gradually turned ice-cold—if fate intended to make him an enemy of his loved ones, then he would completely overturn this game. Whether it be the Holy Sect, the Imperial Court, or that "Chess Player" lurking in the shadows, he would make them all understand: a chess player driven into a corner can sometimes be far more terrifying than the one who holds the pieces.
